notes: Official chemistry-olympiad portal emblem: red/blue curves around a benzene hexagon. The official portal directly links the chemistry-olympiad YouTube channel; this mark is cropped from that channel own 900x900 profile image, box [152,674,256,802]. The identical emblem appears in the official portal header https://d2j16w31g89z0j.cloudfront.net/site/chemolympiad/header/olympiad_logo.png and favicon. Original mark proportions and red/blue/black colours retained, including the original pale-blue background; no title, recolouring, upscale or redraw. This 104x128 source crop is sharper than the portal favicon.
